notes.title: Update v0.3.0.1

tags.feature: 1. Added 27 new masks, our number of masks has exceeded 100!!!
1.1. Added 13 beast-type masks to improve the "spawning" genre and "attack power" genre;
1.2. Added 5 personality-type masks and introduced a new genre "money ability";
1.3. Added 9 monster-type masks and added masks with different attributes;
2. Added 7 new features:
2.1. Added four "combat power" related features "lone ranger", "follower", "even number" and "odd number" to improve related genres;
2.2. Added "gold panning" and "money ability" features for mutual cooperation;
2.3. Added "death sickle" feature to cooperate with "resurrection" feature.

notes.title: We are at MGN! (& update v0.2.1.2)
notes.content:
[b] We participated in the Steam MGN online independent game launch conference and have been posted on the promotion page! ! ! [/b]

About MGN:
The most casual game carnival, 4.30-5.06 days of excitement!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mgn2024 ]Click to learn more[/url]

About this week’s update:
1. Change the strength of the masks "Chicken" and "Egg";
2. Added new spawning route masks such as "Frog" and "Sparrow".

notes.title: Update v0.2.1.1

tags.bug: 1. Fixed the problem of "when poisoning causes the mask to break, and ultimately causes the player to fail, an additional dice throwing window pops up on the settlement page";
2. Fixed the problem of the Tarot card explanation pop-up box flickering when turning over the Tarot cards.

notes.title: Update v0.2.1.0

tags.feature: 1. Modify the characteristics of "Corpse eater" and add a "Remnant Soul" mask to the deck after the effect is triggered;
2. Added the characteristics of "Spawn", "Devour", "Dissipate" and "Temporary";
3. New "Vampire" masks have been added to the Animal deck: "Leech", "Tyrant Leech" and "Lamprey";
4. Added new egg-laying and devouring routes to the Animal deck: "Chicken", "Owl", "Eagle" and "Pelican".

notes.title: Update v0.2.0.0

tags.feature: 1.1. The dice roll automatically! The dice will be rolled automatically when the number of days changes, or when a new round of combat begins;
1.2. Dice are allocated automatically! After the dice is thrown, it will be automatically assigned to the corresponding action target. Players can also click the swap button to change the assignment;
2.1. When the enemy skill dice is selected, it will be displayed in red to increase attention;
2.2. For tarot cards that have been explored, when the mouse is moved into it, a prompt will pop up to inform you of the event effect, and there is no need to query it through the illustrated book;
3.1. A comment has been added to the "Howl" ability to inform the effect of the additional "Chaos" ability;

tags.balance_change: 3.2. Adjust the skill effects of some enemies to enhance the strength of "King Slime";

tags.bug: 4. Bug fix: Fixed the problem that rapid clicking may cause multiple pop-ups and potions to take effect multiple times.

notes.title: Update v0.1.3.1
notes.content:
[b] Players are welcome to join the QQ group: 285414806, and discuss with us the genre of the game, the types of masks, values and gameplay, etc.[/b]
[b]Note: We forgot to enable search in the QQ group before, and the settings have been modified ːsteamsadː[/b]
This is a small update with the following changes:
According to player feedback, some Tarot events are too weak. This change:
1. Strengthen the event effect of the "Power" tarot card;
2. Strengthen the event effect of the "Moon" Tarot card;
3. The "Priestess" tarot card may give more layers of unknown abilities;
4. The number of ability fragments dropped by "the Wheel of Fortune" will be tripled.

[b]Preview of the next regularly update:[/b]
New mechanisms are currently being developed.
Ability chips can not only be used to synthesize new masks, but will also be able to enhance existing masks.
Stay tuned ~

4. The number of ability fragments dropped by "the Wheel of Fortune" will be tripled.
